//: The authored symbol/doc index for the SH7 static hover prototype. Each entry names a compiler graph node id from site/data/graph.json, the SH4 span classes that identify the token, and a signature that MUST appear verbatim (whitespace-normalised) in the excerpt. node/signature/span are validated by hover.mjs and the hover site gate; the summary is the one authored sentence and the docs link is derived from the node's surface. Add an entry only when the compiler has already produced the symbol; this file is not a second symbol table.

examples.title: A ticket and its refund operations
examples.lede: The domain model behind the support desk: one class, its identity and refund state, and the two operations that guard a refund.

symbols.name: Ticket
symbols.summary: The support ticket aggregate: a stable ticket number, a title, an assignee, and the refund value the approval operations guard.

symbols.name: raiseRefund
symbols.summary: Asks for a refund on this ticket; the operation admits the request while the running total stays at or below 5,000 cents.

symbols.name: approveRefund
symbols.summary: Approves a refund on this ticket; the operation admits up to 100,000 cents.

examples.title: A service, its operation, and the capability that gates it
examples.lede: The application design that orchestrates the domain: a service operation and the policy capability it names.

symbols.name: raiseRefund
symbols.signature: boolean raiseRefund(String ticketNo, int cents) capability RaiseRefund emits RefundRequested
symbols.summary: Raises a refund for a ticket, emits RefundRequested, and is gated by the RaiseRefund capability.

symbols.name: RaiseRefund
symbols.summary: The permission that gates raiseRefund; support.actor declares it on Ticket.
